# HALE MAKAWAO（ハレマカワオ）

> A private vacation rental villa in the Daisen highlands of Tottori, western Japan. One group per day. Up to 12 guests across 5 rooms (about 200 sqm). About 45 minutes by car from Yonago Kitaro Airport (YGJ), with direct flights from Taipei (TPE) twice a week. Just 5 minutes by car to Mt. Daisen ski resort.

## Quick facts

- **Location**: 鈑戸 1542-91, Daisen-cho, Tottori, Japan (postal 689-3317)
- **Coordinates**: 35.3833 N, 133.5333 E
- **Type**: Entire-house vacation rental (一棟貸し / 貸別荘 / 包棟別墅), one booking per day
- **Capacity**: Up to 12 guests in 5 rooms — 3 western-style (2 double, 1 twin) + 2 Japanese-style
- **Size**: About 200 sqm
- **On-site host**: Owner couple live in the same building and greet guests in person at check-in (not a self check-in / unattended rental)
- **Price**: ¥40,000 – ¥60,000 per night
- **Check-in / Check-out**: 15:00 / 10:00
- **Pets**: Not allowed
- **Smoking**: Not allowed
- **Wi-Fi**: Free, fiber-optic >100 Mbps
- **Parking**: Free, 6 cars
- **Languages**: 日本語 / English / 繁體中文

## Best for

- Families with children (small children welcome — fully private property)
- Multi-generational trips (grandparents + parents + kids)
- Ski / snowboard groups (Mt. Daisen ski resort 5 min by car)
- Taiwanese family travelers (direct YGJ ↔ TPE flights since May 2025)
- Off-the-beaten-path Japan travelers (rural Daisen highlands)

## Nearby attractions

- Mt. Daisen / Daisen White Resort ski area — 5 min by car
- Mt. Daisen trailhead (Natsuyama trail) — about 10 min by car
- Sakaiminato (Mizuki Shigeru Road, GeGeGe no Kitaro) — about 50 min
- Izumo Taisha Grand Shrine — about 90 min
- Tottori Sand Dunes — about 70 min
- Daisen highland farms and Daisen G-beer brewery — 10–15 min

## Meals

- Signature French toast morning set (option, advance booking)
- Tottori Wagyu BBQ hands-free set (all gear & ingredients included)
- Local restaurant shuttle plan (Sushi Tamura etc.)
